golden_baseline_location: Live Oracle OW_BILLING via Lakehouse Federation (recon mode LIVE); CUSTOMER_MASTER compared column-by-column at its full declared width, not a selected subset.

acceptance_checks.description: Every money column is DECIMAL(14,2) end to end and reconciles exactly to the cent against the source population (T1). A DOUBLE anywhere in a money lineage rejects the PR.

loaded_rows + quarantined_rows == source_rows for every table in the unit, and the quarantine count is reported next to every money figure (T2/T3, §Quarantine). Quarantine above 5% of source rows halts the unit and escalates (STOPA-QUARANTINE).
Rerunning the job with identical inputs produces zero net change: MERGE on the declared key plus ns, proven by a second run whose recon report shows the same row counts and checksums.

Every target row carries ns, every volume path is <ns>/<unit>/..., the job accepts ns as a parameter, and the recon report states the ns it ran under. Nothing unprefixed by ow_tp is read, written or deleted.

Every PII column of customer_master carries a Unity Catalog column mask restricting cleartext to the migration principal (STOPA-PII). A PR that lands a PII column without a mask is rejected, and no unmasked PII may be copied to gold or an export.
VARCHAR2(9) date columns are parsed per D-05/D-06: unparseable values quarantine the row with reason BAD_DATE, and the 2-digit-year window is the explicit source window, not Java's 80-year pivot.
entity_attr_value is migrated as the EAV table it is, with attribute names and values preserved verbatim; it is not pivoted, deduplicated, or type-inferred during bronze.
No column of the wide tables is dropped as unused. A column with 100% NULLs still lands, because absence in bronze cannot be distinguished later from absence in the source.

planted_anomalies.description: VARCHAR2(9) DD-MON-YY free-text dates in customer_master, including values that do not parse at all.
GL_ACCT_CSV holds a comma-separated list inside one column.
entity_attr_value stores every attribute as text regardless of its real type.
invoice_line/invoice_header duplicate invoice data that also exists in the normalised invoices/invoice_lines tables, with no FK and no guarantee the two agree.
planted_anomalies.reason: Reconciling the denormalised copies against the normalised tables is a source data-quality question, not a migration parity question; both sides are migrated as-is and the disagreement is reported, not resolved. Declared here so it is not mistaken for a conversion defect.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Values are carried through as Unicode text without re-encoding; no transliteration, no NFC/NFD normalisation, no whitespace trimming. A trailing-space-padded CHAR column keeps its padding.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Unconvertible bytes are not silently replaced: the row is quarantined with reason ENC_INVALID and counted in recon.

malformed_record_policy.details: Source NULL and empty string are distinct and must stay distinct: a NULL stays NULL, a zero-length VARCHAR2 stays zero-length. Never coalesce NULL to '' or to 0 to make a comparison pass. An unexpected extra column from the source fails the unit rather than being ignored, because a schema drift no one declared is a correctness event.

empty_input_semantics.details: Same as bronze_core: empty in, empty out for this ns, with an explicit recon report. Never delete another ns's slice.
